purpose: In-game RTS world asset request/import manifest for the WarlineCapture fictional Gulf 2D isometric vertical slice.

sharedArtDirection.style: premium 2D isometric mobile RTS, fictional Gulf coastal city battlefield, stylized 2.5D/3D render quality
sharedArtDirection.camera: fixed isometric gameplay angle matching FG-L01 visual target
sharedArtDirection.lighting: warm upper-left key light, cool readable shadows, crisp silhouettes, no heavy black crush
sharedArtDirection.scale: readable on mobile at RTS zoom over FG-L01 roads, plazas, rooftops, and seawall
sharedArtDirection.factionAccents: friendly cyan/blue accent details, enemy red accent details, neutral muted civilian tones; do not recolor the full unit

outputRequirements.worldSprites: PNG with alpha, separate contact shadow layer preferred
outputRequirements.animations: sprite sheet or frame sequence with stable pivot and consistent bounds per state
outputRequirements.facings: initial vertical slice may use 4 facings: NE, SE, SW, NW; expand to 8 facings after validation
outputRequirements.manifestPerAsset: each delivered asset must include source prompt, visual id, paths, state names, frame counts, pivot, scale, and notes
outputRequirements.unityImport: Sprite texture, uncompressed during validation, no mip maps during visual approval, bilinear filtering

assetRequests.prompt: Create an in-game 2D isometric RTS sprite animation set for a modern rifle soldier in the WarlineCapture fictional Gulf style. Tan/olive tactical uniform, helmet with dark visor/goggles, compact rifle, clean readable silhouette, friendly blue accent variant and enemy red accent variant. Generate idle, walk, run, aim, fire, hit, and death frame sequences from fixed isometric gameplay camera, transparent background, stable ground pivot, separate soft contact shadow. No UI, no health bars, no flags, no text, no gore.

No UI, no health bars, no flags, no readable text, no gore.

fullProductionCoverageRequests.purpose: Full in-game RTS art coverage beyond the first FG01 vertical slice. These assets should be requested in batches after the first slice proves scale, pivots, sorting, and style.

vfxAndProjectiles.requirements: Transparent loop/frame sequences, fixed isometric lighting, separate flash/smoke/debris where useful, no UI or text.
Reusable runtime overlays for buildings, vehicles, aircraft crash states, and map hazards.
Projectile sprites and trail/impact frame sequences with directional variants for NE, SE, SW, NW.
Small readable flashes that layer on weapons without baked health bars or selection markers.

allSoldierAnimationSets.requirements: Every soldier/character animation set must keep stable ground pivot, consistent scale, separate contact shadow, readable weapon/role silhouette, and faction accents as separate variants where relevant.

allBuildingStateSets.requirements: Every building state must keep the same socket footprint and pivot. Construction, destruction, fire, smoke, and rubble can use shared overlays, but must align cleanly with the building sprite.
